status: Methodology v2: v1 (frozen 2026-10-01) plus a researcher-configurable constant pre-reheating equation of state w_R per reheating scenario. At w_R = 0 it reproduces v1 bit for bit (METHODOLOGY.md, section "Methodology v2")

run.approval_note: The Julia driver refuses an abundance run on more than max_rows_abundance_without_approval modes unless run.production_run_approved is true. The composed run configuration takes this value from the run file (default false); the methodology template carries no approval.

input.spectrum_checksums: per-geometry spectrum_source_sha256 in the manifest; every file is re-hashed by A1 (scripts/01_a1_input_adapter.py); the sorted (geometry_id, sha256) list is hashed into spectrum_set_sha256 in results/a1_input_verification.json
input.canonical_ids: geometry_id from the manifest (h11_XXX/np_POSITION/cy_0000001, unified position); mode key = (geometry_id, mode_index). File-internal polytope labels are never used as identifiers.
input.pinning_note: 02_write_run_config.py records the sha256 of the relic-input manifest, of the A1 canonical mode table and of the spectrum set actually used; the Julia driver refuses a population run whose mode table differs from the recorded checksum

code.cyaxiverse_repo: CYAxiverse.jl branch vmm; byte-identical reproduction of the Shoroq reference is demonstrated at commit a5eacd8cd4a5905161cab239a461ba252c64e8e0 (configs/paths.env.example); the engine itself needs only the g* table and the spectra files
code.relic_script: engine/relic/compute_relic_abundance.jl (physics block byte-identical to the frozen production script; see PROVENANCE.md)
code.physics_core_origin: legacy compute_tosc_abundance_hfull.jl (sha256 6af20481...) + approved edits E1-E6 + Fuzzy pre-reheating F1-F5, audited 2026-10-01
code.fuzzy_paper: Sheridan et al., Fuzzy Axions and Associated Relics, arXiv:2412.12012 v1
code.julia: Julia 1.8.4 (version used for the frozen production run)
code.python: Python 3.11 with numpy, scipy, pandas, h5py, mpmath

cosmology.H0_definition: CYAxiverse generate.constants()['Hubble'] = 2.13*0.7e-33 eV, the VMM physical-spectrum threshold (Float64 2.13*0.7*1e-33 == 1.491e-33)
cosmology.omega_m_definition: Omega_m h^2 = 0.315*0.674^2 = 0.14309694 (quoted 0.14310): physical matter density of the legacy Planck-2018 cosmology, held fixed (E2)
cosmology.Omega_r0_definition: (pi^2/30) g_rho(T0) T0^4 / (3 M_pl^2 H0^2) (E3; radiation fixed by T_CMB, not by h)
cosmology.gstar_source: Saikawa & Shirai 2018, arXiv:1803.01038 (standardmodel2018.dat): column 2 g_*rho, column 4 g_*s; log-log interpolation, clamped to the end values outside [1.9953e-6, 9.9739e16] GeV
cosmology.derived_reference: implementation B (50-digit mpmath); cross-checked against implementation C (float64) to < 1e-12

axion.f_relic_definition: f_relic = 1 * f_pert = m/sqrt|lambda_self| (the f of Lambda^4 [1 - cos(phi/f)]; C = 1 proven in the method audit)
axion.theta_rescaling: Omega(theta) = Omega(pi/2) * [theta/(pi/2)]^2 (harmonic; applied only in post-processing)
axion.theta_ref_interpretation: pi/2 is a normalisation/reference angle ONLY; it is not an adopted, preferred, best-fit or allowed physical angle. Every abundance field is named *_at_theta_ref.
axion.theta_small_angle_domain: NOT YET ESTABLISHED: recovered separately from the legacy analysis and the Fuzzy paper before any theta analysis; pi/2 is not assumed to be inside it
axion.theta_rescaling_validity: only inside the approved small-angle (harmonic) domain; rho_a ~ theta^2 without anharmonic correction
axion.initial_energy_density: rho_a(onset) = (1/2) m_a^2 f^2 theta_i^2 (harmonic, no anharmonic factor)

categories.LATE: 3 H0 < m_a <= 3 H(T_eq)  (onset after matter-radiation equality: T_osc <= T_eq)
categories.PRE_REHEATING: m_a > 3 H_R  (onset before reheating; T_osc undefined)

oscillation.classification_rule: thresholds 3H0 = 3 Hfull(T_CMB), 3 Hfull(T_eq), 3 H_R; for LATE/POST the abundance run also solves 3 Hfull(T_osc) = m_a and stops if (T_osc <= T_eq) disagrees with the threshold class
oscillation.post_reheating_abundance: Omega h^2 = (1/2) m^2 f^2 theta^2 (g_s0/g_s(T_osc)) (T0/T_osc)^3 / (3 M_pl^2 H100^2)

reheating.w_R_default_meaning: value used by a scenario that does not state w_R; w_R = 0 is the v1 modulus-domination scenario (Fuzzy scenario (2))

w_R_domain.rule: -1 < w_R <= 1, finite number (boolean, string and null are refused)
w_R_domain.lower_reason: H(a) ~ a^(-3(1+w_R)/2) must decrease as the universe expands, so that 3H = m_a is reached before reheating for m_a > 3H_R: this requires 1+w_R > 0 (w_R = -1 is a constant-H de Sitter phase with no onset; w_R < -1 has H growing with a)
w_R_domain.upper_reason: w_R <= 1: causal (sound speed <= c) fluid; w_R = 1 is kination
w_R_domain.warn_accelerated_text: w_R < -1/3: the pre-reheating epoch is accelerating (a_ddot > 0), i.e. it is a continuation of inflation-like expansion rather than a conventional reheating epoch; the instantaneous transition to radiation then needs a microphysical interpretation that this prescription does not provide
w_R_domain.warn_near_de_sitter_text: w_R < -0.9: 1+z_a ~ (m/3H_R)^(2/(3(1+w_R))) grows very steeply; abundances can leave the float64 range and the run stops if one does (never clamped)
w_R_domain.warn_radiation_like_text: w_R = 1/3: the pre-reheating epoch is radiation-like, so the PRE prescription describes an extended radiation era; ok mathematically, check that this is the intended history
w_R_domain.onset_systematic_note_text: w_R < 0: the sudden-onset (3H = m) estimate overestimates the exact field evolution by a factor that grows quickly as w_R decreases (idealised constant-mass power-law setups: 4.0 at w_R = 0, 10.6 at -1/3, 28 at -1/2; METHODOLOGY.md, Methodology v2); results are results of the stated prescription, not precision predictions, and no output is rescaled

reheating.pre_reheating_prescription: Fuzzy arXiv:2412.12012 Sec. 2: (2.1) 1+z_R; (2.2) H(z) = H_R ((1+z)/(1+z_R))^(3(1+w_R)/2) for z >= z_R with rho_r(T_R) = 3 H_R^2 M_pl^2 (radiation only), instantaneous transition to radiation at T_R; (2.15) 1+z_a = (1+z_R)(m_a/3H_R)^(2/(3(1+w_R))) for m_a > 3H_R; (2.10) Omega h^2 = m^2 f^2 theta^2 / [2 (1+z_a)^3 3 M_pl^2 H100^2]
reheating.pre_reheating_relative_scaling: Omega(w_R) / Omega(0) = (m_a / 3H_R)^(2 w_R / (1 + w_R)) at fixed m_a, f, theta, T_R
reheating.pre_reheating_evaluation: w_R == 0.0: the v1 power form (bit-identical to v1); w_R != 0: ln Omega = ln[m^2 f^2 theta^2 / (2 rho_c/h^2)] - 3 ln(1+z_R) - [2/(1+w_R)] ln(m/3H_R) evaluated in logarithms; a result outside the float64 range stops the run (no clamping)
reheating.eq_2_16_note: The printed closed form (2.16) is 2.5034x the paper's own (2.10)+(2.15) for every mode; the paper's worked examples (4.7), (4.11) follow (2.10)+(2.15). Only (2.10)+(2.15) is used (FUZZY_PRE_REHEATING_FOLLOWUP.md).
reheating.T_osc_for_pre_reheating: undefined (no thermal bath before reheating in the paper's parameterisation); reported as NA, with 1+z_a and H_osc = m_a/3
reheating.constant_w_R_caveat: A constant effective w_R with instantaneous reheating is a model prescription, not a microphysical reheating model. Class boundaries (3H_R), POST abundances and inflation validity do not depend on w_R.

LATE.reason: thesis-analysis choice (onset after equality); its formula value is kept in Omega_h2_late_census_only_at_theta_ref

inflation_cut.rule: a mode with m_a > 3 H_I,max is excluded from the misalignment abundance (state INFLATIONARY_VALIDITY_EXCLUDED); m_a <= 3 H_I,max is valid
inflation_cut.source: Fuzzy arXiv:2412.12012 footnote 16 (p. 14): 'we always discard axions with masses m_a > 3H_I,max ~ 1.4 x 10^14 GeV, where H_I,max is the observational bound due to CMB measurements'
inflation_cut.precision_note: Neither the paper nor its supplementary notebook gives a formula or a more precise value; 1.4e14 GeV is the paper's stated threshold and is used as stated. Sensitivity to the CMB-bound convention is reported in results/dry_run_census_check.json.
inflation_cut.interpretation: excluded from the calculated misalignment abundance because the assumed inflationary displacement prescription is not valid (the axion is heavier than H_I during inflation and its onset would precede the end of inflation); NOT a prediction of zero abundance

mKK_flag.V: CY volume, cytools/geometric/CY_volume of the spectrum file
mKK_flag.source: Fuzzy supplementary notebook cell 24 (mPl_GeV = 2.4e18; cy.compute_cy_volume(kahler)); the paper imposes no m_a < m_KK cut
mKK_flag.not_used: sqrt(pi) g_s^(1/4) prefactor (an earlier mistaken recollection)

light_window_100eV.note: legacy LIGHT_LOG10M_MAX_EV = 2.0 was a thesis light-population window ('NOT a universal stability boundary'); removed

outputs.per_scenario_identity: scenario label, T_reh_GeV and w_R are written in every table row (column w_R); a (T_reh_GeV, w_R) pair may appear once per run
